keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Jeremy Toljan (Levante).
Substitution, Levante. Nacho Pérez replaces Jeremy Toljan because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Aïssa Mandi (Levante) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Elche. Thomas Lemar replaces Abiel Osorio.
Second Half begins Levante 0, Elche 0.
Thiago Fernández (Levante) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Manu Sánchez (Levante).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Levante. Marc Santos replaces Manu Sánchez because of an injury.
Goal! Levante 0, Elche 1. Roy Revivo (Elche) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Germán Valera.
Substitution, Elche. Martim Neto replaces Gonzalo Villar.
Oriol Rey (Levante) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Levante. Petar Ratkov replaces Iván Romero.
Substitution, Levante. Karl Etta Eyong replaces Oriol Rey.
Substitution, Elche. Tete Morente replaces Lucas Cepeda.
Substitution, Elche. Matia Barzic replaces Roy Revivo.
Federico Redondo (Elche) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Levante 1, Elche 1. Dani Requena (Levante) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jon Ander Olasagasti with a headed pass.
Substitution, Elche. Grady Diangana replaces Thomas Lemar.
Dani Requena (Levante) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
